description: Unit tests for the DNS configuration service in Chromium, testing configuration reading, invalidation, and host parsing behaviors.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceTest
classes.description: Test fixture for DNS config service unit tests, managing setup, teardown, and helper methods for testing config read, invalidation, and host parsing.

classes.name: MockHostsParserFactory
classes.description: Mock class for DNS hosts parser factory, used to simulate host parsing behavior in tests.

methods.name: OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when DNS configuration changes, updates last_config_ and possibly quits the run loop.

methods.name: WaitForConfig
methods.description: Waits until a DNS config notification is received.

methods.name: WaitForInvalidationTimeout
methods.description: Waits for the invalidation timeout and verifies config is reset to default.

methods.name: ValidateNoNotification
methods.description: Ensures no config notification occurs within the timeout period.

methods.name: MakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a DnsConfig object with a specified seed for testing.

methods.name: MakeHosts
methods.description: Creates a DnsHosts object with entries based on a seed.

methods.name: SetUpService
methods.description: Initializes the DNS config service and sets up config change watching.
